result.prompt: Create a 10-second text-to-video promotional motion graphic for Instagram Reels, featuring an oversized discount card in vertical 9:16. Use crisp 2D vector animation, bold red-and-white display typography, flat graphic lighting, clean matte surfaces, and an upbeat, confident mood; the movement is punchy but easy to follow. One continuous shot, with the same white card, red background, lettering, and layout throughout. From 0–5 seconds, in a centered medium-wide composition, the white promotional card with its thick red border slides upward into the middle of a solid red field as the camera gently pushes in; its red lettering reads exactly "20% OFF · This weekend only", arranged with the discount enormous above the smaller weekend message, all comfortably inside Reel-safe margins. From 5–10 seconds, in a centered close framing, the card with its thick red border makes one subtle scale-up, easing to a complete stop by 8 seconds; the surrounding red field remains plain and the camera stays locked, preserving the full card and every letter. Audio off: no music, speech, or sound effects. Hold the completely still, fully readable final image from 8–10 seconds. Use a vivid red-and-clean-white grade, sharp edges, strong contrast, and brisk opening movement followed by a calm reading pause. This is a standalone social promotion, not a scene from a larger film; no products or people are shown. Negatives: no additional words, logos, watermarks, illegible or changing letters, cropped text, flicker, motion blur, gradients, or decorative clutter.
